notes.title: Office Battle updated to version 1.02
notes.content:
You still can build barricades. Enemies can't move big items. It will help in Survival mode. But you won't earn XP and weapons. 

Were made some changes in gameplay:

- Fixed bug with skill points
- Now you can't kick people through the walls 
- Fixed some errors in code

tags.bug: - Now you can't kick people through the walls

notes.title: Office Battle updated to version 1.01
notes.content:
We fixed some bugs and errors that was found in version 1.00

Updates:
- Fixed some translation issues in shop and inventory
- Fixed "fix" button, lol =)
- Updated some UI objects
- Updated physics (heavier objects, harder to use barricades)
